rationale.conceptual: The method is standard DFT with hybrid functional applied to defect physics. Setup involves constructing correct supercells, handling vacuum thickness, setting k-point sampling and pseudopotentials for hybrid functional DFT. Not a single script but not extremely fragile; typical multi-stage DFT workflow.
